providers.name: X Money
providers.requirements: Premium+ subscription, or $1,000 in qualifying deposits within 34 days for 6.00% APY.
providers.details: Rolling out to select US users aged 18+. No interest for New York residents. Qualifying deposits include eligible ACH direct deposits and X creator payouts. Subscription fees may reduce earnings.
providers.protection: Pass-through FDIC eligibility through Cross River Bank and sweep program banks; conditions and aggregate limits apply.

fdic.label: FDIC · Conditional
fdic.summary: Pass-through coverage through partner banks; sweep program conditions apply.

providers.name: Cash App
providers.requirements: Green status: $300 in qualifying deposits or $500 in qualifying purchases per month.
providers.details: Savings yield enrollment and eligibility required. Have a Cash App Card or sponsor a sponsored account, and qualify for Green. Sponsored accounts may earn the higher rate with sponsor approval. No monthly savings fee or minimum balance. Business accounts are ineligible. The current savings page displays 3.50%; an older learning article still displays 3.25%.
providers.protection: Conditional FDIC pass-through eligibility through program banks; limits aggregate with your other deposits at each bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Conditional
fdic.summary: Eligible balances at program banks; card and pass-through requirements apply.

providers.name: Wealthfront
providers.requirements: Top rate combines a new-client boost with investing and recurring-deposit requirements.
providers.details: New clients: +0.65 percentage points for 3 months on up to $150,000. An additional +0.25 requires an eligible funded investing account and $1,000 monthly direct deposits or $2,500 recurring deposits. Zero account fees. The headline boost does not last a full year; see promotion terms for eligibility and balance limits.
providers.protection: Cash swept to FDIC-insured program banks. Wealthfront is a brokerage, not a bank; pass-through conditions and aggregate limits apply.

fdic.label: FDIC · Conditional
fdic.summary: Applies to cash swept to program banks, subject to program conditions.

providers.name: Marcus
providers.requirements: No monthly fee or minimum deposit. Referral promotions are excluded here.
providers.details: Variable savings APY. Maximum balance limits apply. Offered by Goldman Sachs Bank USA. Optional referral boosts are not included in this listing.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured bank deposit, subject to standard depositor, bank, and ownership-category limits.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Goldman Sachs Bank USA; standard coverage limits apply.

providers.name: Ally
providers.requirements: No minimum opening deposit or monthly maintenance fee.
providers.details: Variable APY, currently the same across all balance tiers. Certain withdrawals and transfers are limited to 10 per statement cycle; consult account terms.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured bank deposit, subject to standard depositor, bank, and ownership-category limits.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Ally Bank; standard coverage limits apply.

providers.name: Coinbase
providers.requirements: Coinbase One membership, starting at $4.99/month. Account and region eligibility apply.
providers.details: Publicly advertised USDC reward APY. Hold at least $1 USDC and meet trading and region eligibility. Coinbase One is required in the US; no non-member US base rate is offered. Your account shows the applicable rate, which can vary. Membership cost reduces net earnings.
providers.protection: Crypto rewards, not an insured bank deposit. Stablecoin depegging and platform custody risks apply.

fdic.label: Not FDIC insured
fdic.summary: USDC is a crypto asset, not an insured bank deposit.

providers.name: Kraken
providers.requirements: Up to 4.00% with Kraken+; up to 2.00% without. Enable Stablecoin Rewards.
providers.details: USDC rewards are available to eligible customers in the US, Canada, Australia, and UK. No holding lockup or USDC rewards fee; Kraken+ subscription costs may apply. Rates are variable and advertised as “up to.”
providers.protection: Not covered by FDIC or other deposit insurance. Stablecoin depegging and platform custody risks apply.

fdic.label: Not FDIC insured
fdic.summary: Stablecoin rewards are not covered by deposit insurance.

providers.name: E*TRADE
providers.requirements: New Premium Savings Accounts opened by January 10, 2027. Promotional APY applies for six months.
providers.details: Offered by Morgan Stanley Private Bank. No minimum opening deposit or monthly account fee. Promotion applies to eligible new accounts opened September 22, 2026–January 10, 2027, on balances up to $10 million; exceeding the cap may revert the entire balance to the standard rate. Existing accounts are ineligible. After six months, the variable base APY applies. Separate cash bonuses are excluded.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured bank deposit with an enhanced coverage program; depositor, ownership, and program-bank aggregation limits apply.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Morgan Stanley Private Bank; enhanced coverage program conditions apply.

providers.name: Robinhood
providers.requirements: Robinhood Gold ($5/month) and enrollment for eligible cash in self-directed taxable investing accounts.
providers.details: Variable rate, effective September 17, 2026. Applies to eligible settled cash, including options collateral. Up to $10,000 of eligible uninvested cash stays in the Brokerage-Held Cash Program; amounts above that are swept to banks. Managed Robinhood Strategies accounts also earn this rate on swept cash without Gold. Fees reduce net earnings.
providers.protection: Protection depends on where cash is held. Brokerage-held cash is not an FDIC-insured bank deposit; bank-swept cash is subject to program-bank deposit coverage terms. Robinhood is not a bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Mixed coverage
fdic.summary: Swept bank cash is eligible. Brokerage-held cash and options collateral are not FDIC insured.

providers.name: Aave
providers.requirements: Supply USDC to the Ethereum Core / Main market. Requires a compatible wallet and ETH for network fees.
providers.details: Displayed deposit APY observed on Aave Pro at 2026-10-04 05:17 UTC. This is one USDC market, not a protocol-wide rate. Rates change with market utilisation and governance parameters; other assets, networks, and markets have different yields. Network fees reduce net returns. Withdrawals depend on available liquidity and, if borrowing, collateral requirements.
providers.protection: No FDIC deposit insurance. Smart-contract, oracle, liquidity, and stablecoin depegging risks apply. Borrowing against supplied assets also introduces liquidation risk.

fdic.label: Not FDIC insured
fdic.summary: Onchain lending, not a bank deposit; smart-contract and liquidity risks apply.
